claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is scheduled for March 4–17, 2026.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic is exclusively broadcast in the U.S. across the FOX family of networks, including FOX, FS1, FS2, and FOX Deportes.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic consists of 47 games.
All 47 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic stream live on FOX One.
All 47 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic stream live via Fubo.
All 47 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic stream live via Tubi.
All 47 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic stream live via the FOX Sports app.
TV channels for the 2026 World Baseball Classic in the USA are FOX, FS1, FS2, FOX Deportes.
Streaming services for the 2026 World Baseball Classic are FOX One (premium), Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV, Tubi.
Free audio streams of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are available via MLB.com.
Free audio streams of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are available via Sirius XM.
Sportsnet broadcasts the 2026 World Baseball Classic in English in Canada.
TVA Sports broadcasts the 2026 World Baseball Classic in French in Canada.
Netflix broadcasts the 2026 World Baseball Classic in Japan.
WAPA Deportes broadcasts the 2026 World Baseball Classic in Puerto Rico.
A semifinal of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is USA vs. Dominican Republic on March 15.
A semifinal of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is Venezuela vs. Italy on March 16.
The final of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is on March 17, 2026.
The final stages of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are centered around Miami (loanDepot park).
